import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    nums1 = list(map(int, data[idx:idx + n]))
    idx += n
    m = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    nums2 = list(map(int, data[idx:idx + m]))
    idx += m
    
    set1 = set(nums1)
    set2 = set(nums2)
    
    intersection = list(set1 & set2)
    
    if not intersection:
        print(-1)
    else:
        print(' '.join(map(str, intersection)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
